instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova is a micro-brokerage specializing in residential and light commercial real estate transactions, currently managing an average of 600 closed deals annually across its eight offices. The company focuses on leveraging data to provide streamlined market intelligence for agents and clients.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company utilizes a formal internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas quarterly, ensuring controlled resource allocation. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation, focusing initially on operational efficiency and minor digital tooling prototypes.
answers.strategicGoals: Given the structural decline in traditional real estate, Nova aims to identify entirely new value propositions by exploring adjacent service lines like specialized property management tech or hyper-local market data consulting. The goal is to build diversified revenue streams that are less exposed to cyclical transaction volumes.
answers.additionalContext: Nova currently faces high competition from large national platforms but maintains a strong local reputation. The primary challenge is resource scarcity, making innovation cycles slow and highly constrained by operational demands.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Refinement of AI-Powered Valuation Suite for Niche Assets
opportunities.rationale: Enhancing the existing proprietary property valuation model with machine learning to better handle unique or under-served micro-market data. This leverages existing developer talent and improves core operational efficiency without requiring massive new infrastructure.

first_actions: Identify 3 key data sets for ML refinement
Allocate 2 dedicated developer weeks monthly for model iteration
Pilot the refined model with 10 high-value transactions
resources_needed: Additional licensing for specialized data feeds ($5k)
Developer time allocation (budgeted in existing overhead)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in transaction valuation error rate by 10%
milestones: Q4: Closed pilot testing results reviewed

opportunities.title: Launch 'Nova Connect' - Local Property Management Tech Beta
opportunities.rationale: Develop a lightweight, subscription-based SaaS tool offering basic property management and tenant communication features targeted at the 8 offices. This diversifies revenue away from pure transaction fees into recurring service income.

first_actions: Define MVP feature set (tenant portal, lease tracking)
Establish partnerships with 2 local property managers for beta testing
resources_needed: Software development sprint budget (4% of total budget)
Legal review for consumer data compliance
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 paying beta subscribers within 6 months
milestones: Month 4: Beta launch and feedback loop completion

next_steps.action: Formalize the requirements for the 'Nova Connect' MVP and secure initial development resources.
Schedule a deep dive workshop on cross-functional talent allocation to address 'talent' barrier in the short term.

key_weaknesses: Severe constraint on dedicated R&D/Innovation headcount leading to slow initiative velocity.
High dependency on a single owner for strategic decision-making, increasing operational risk if the founder is unavailable.
Formal processes creating bureaucratic friction that hinders fast prototyping and testing cycles.
Low digital maturity (level 3) limits ability to scale any new technology beyond basic internal tooling.
